semantic_review.method: Independent canonical unordered edge reconstruction followed by candidate-specific required-axis review over authority/owner, lifecycle/state transition, user outcome, state boundary, and failure semantics; forbidden umbrella/member, adjacency, dependency, shared vocabulary/UI, related-command, broader/narrower, complementary-workflow equivalence was quarantined.

edge_normalization: Each edge is the lexicographically sorted pair of provisional_feature_ref values joined by one actual U+0000 separator; arrays and digests are computed over compact UTF-8 JSON.
